observations: Photo 0 shows a white plastic tank held in a galvanized steel cage, with a black screw cap on top.
A human hand is touching the front of the cage, giving a rough size reference consistent with a standard IBC tote.
Background shows a stack of similar tanks and cages, several with visible surface rust and weathering.
No brand, model, or capacity markings are legible anywhere on the tank or cage.
The bottom outlet valve is not visible in this photo.
A watermark reading 'EMMALINK CONCEPT NIG' is overlaid on the image.

identity.kind: IBC tank (intermediate bulk container) for liquid storage

claims.claim: Suitable for storage of water or any liquid
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a generic IBC design, but prior contents and chemical compatibility are not shown or stated.
No stress test, crack, or load-bearing shot provided; strength cannot be judged from a static photo.

risks.risk: Tank may be a reconditioned IBC that previously held chemicals, which would make it unsafe for drinking water despite seller's 'any liquid' claim.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any UN/HazMat code, prior-contents label, or interior shot through the cap.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/previous-chemical-use grade, not food/water-safe grade

risks.risk: Plastic bladder may have hairline cracks, cloudiness, or UV brittleness not visible at this angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all four side panels and the base in daylight, plus a photo with water inside to check for seepage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic/condition unknown, i.e. lower than 'like new'

risks.risk: Steel cage shows rust on other units in the background; the actual unit for sale may have similar corrosion affecting structural support.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the full cage of the specific unit being sold, including welds and base skids.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having some cage corrosion, not rust-free

risks.risk: Bottom outlet valve condition and presence are unverified; a missing or broken valve lowers usability for liquid dispensing.
risks.proof: Photo of the bottom valve/outlet, including a close-up of its threads and handle.

risks.risk: Actual liquid capacity not confirmed (standard IBCs are 1000L but smaller variants exist).
risks.proof: Photo of any capacity marking/plate on the tank or cage, or a tape measure against the unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower end of common IBC capacities

proof_requests: Close-up of any capacity plate, UN code, or prior-contents label on the tank shoulder.
Photo of the bottom outlet valve and its condition.
Full-cage photo of the specific unit (not the stack in the background) showing rust/condition.
Photo of tank filled or partially filled with water to check for leaks.
response.reason: This is clearly an IBC tank by type, and even though several claims (safety for 'any liquid', strength) are unverified, the item can be priced at a worst-case condition (unknown prior contents, unconfirmed valve, possible cage rust) pending further proof.
